propositions.name: bound_transition_identity
propositions.statement: A scientific-state transition must bind subject, problem and comparison identity, source/evidence basis, representation or evaluator epoch, and authority scope; silent mutation creates a new comparison or an invalid transition.
propositions.claimed_residual: one transition identity spanning evidence, representation, evaluator and authority changes
propositions.strongest_counterexample: legitimate calibration iteration where scientific continuity is preserved through a relation rather than immutable fields
propositions.falsifier: F0 configuration/provenance/metrology products produce identical decisions without a cross-parent transition object

propositions.name: warrant_factorization_and_weakest_link_ceiling
propositions.statement: When a claim depends materially on source, semantic interpretation, model, computation, oracle or test, argument, transport and authority, its warranted scope cannot exceed the weakest necessary link and no link may be inferred valid from another.
propositions.claimed_residual: cross-parent validity composition and weakest-link diagnosis
propositions.strongest_counterexample: formal theorem whose proof and specification are fully sufficient without empirical-world links
propositions.falsifier: mature assurance plus VVUQ and oracle methods already produce identical weakest-link decisions with equal or lower cost

propositions.name: typed_relation_uncertainty_and_dependence_conservation
propositions.statement: Relation family, direction, approximation, uncertainty form, dependence, translation loss and unresolved distinctions cannot silently strengthen, disappear or become exact through composition.
propositions.claimed_residual: common non-laundering rule across heterogeneous native relation families
propositions.strongest_counterexample: domain-specific composition theorem already preserves all relevant native semantics
propositions.falsifier: no cross-family decision remains after native relation composition is correctly applied

propositions.name: error_detection_adequacy
propositions.statement: A pass supports only the registered error classes that the evaluator or oracle had a warranted capacity to expose under the selected cases, perturbations and stopping history.
propositions.claimed_residual: one claim-relative adequacy interface across statistical, formal, computational and semantic evaluators
propositions.strongest_counterexample: exact proof or exhaustive known-answer test with complete claim-relevant coverage
propositions.falsifier: native evaluator methods already expose adequacy in every relevant case and the common layer adds only metadata

propositions.name: selective_invalidation_and_reopening
propositions.statement: Invalidation of evidence, relation, computation or evaluator state reopens only commitments whose complete sufficient support has failed; independently sufficient support remains standing.
propositions.claimed_residual: selective reopening across heterogeneous support and validity objects
propositions.strongest_counterexample: ATMS/support-hypergraph parent exactly handles every support mode
propositions.falsifier: parent support-family machinery reproduces the integrated reopen decision with no semantic gap

propositions.name: exploration_confirmation_separation
propositions.statement: Exploratory and constructive actions may expand observables, representations, instruments and problem frames, but their outputs do not gain confirmatory status without subsequent discrimination and testing.
propositions.claimed_residual: controlled transition from exploratory state construction to confirmatory warrant
propositions.strongest_counterexample: native automated-discovery or experimental-design parent already tracks proposal/evidence status and cost
propositions.falsifier: integrated action modes add no discovery or validity value beyond parents

propositions.name: parent_recovery_and_local_deference
propositions.statement: A higher-order theory must recover critical native parent decisions within their valid scope or provide explicit counterevidence and revision; when a parent is sufficient and more efficient, the higher layer remains inactive.
propositions.claimed_residual: formalized local deference as part of higher-theory validity
propositions.strongest_counterexample: no cross-parent theory is needed if local routing plus interfaces always suffices
propositions.falsifier: F2 cannot recover parent suites or cannot deactivate without losing its claimed architecture

propositions.name: machine_native_internal_freedom_external_witness
propositions.statement: Machine cognition may use nonhuman internal representations and search processes, but adoption of a scientific transition requires a claim-relative external witness sufficient for evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, relation, affected commitments and authority.
propositions.strongest_counterexample: a native formal certificate or domain validator is already fully sufficient and no higher witness is needed
propositions.falsifier: machine-native gains disappear under stronger parents, resource matching or external witness requirements

propositions.name: bounded_closure_censorship_and_reopening
propositions.statement: Scientific closure is relative to a declared search and evaluation universe, censored routes, residual uncertainty and omission challenge; a material new route, parent or criterion reopens the terminal.
propositions.claimed_residual: common bounded-closure semantics across literature, computation, experiment and authority routes
propositions.strongest_counterexample: domain-native stopping rules plus explicit scope already provide complete closure semantics
propositions.falsifier: the cross-domain closure object adds no decision value or is too conservative to be usable

admission_requirements: at least two materially different domains for cross-domain status
